description: This Java class implements a MongoDB command listener that reports the execution time of commands to Kamon metrics, including logging details for command start, success, and failure events.

classes.name: KamonCommandListener
classes.description: A listener for MongoDB commands that logs and records execution times to Kamon metrics.

methods.name: KamonCommandListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the timer name based on the provided metric name.

methods.name: commandStarted
methods.description: Logs details when a MongoDB command is started.

methods.name: commandSucceeded
methods.description: Logs and records the elapsed time when a MongoDB command succeeds.

methods.name: commandFailed
methods.description: Logs and records the elapsed time when a MongoDB command fails.

methods.name: recordElapsedTime
methods.description: Records the command execution time to Kamon metrics with appropriate tags.
